lines.zh: 冰面上八条骨腿敲出细碎的响。
lines.en: Eight bone legs rap a fine clatter across the ice.

lines.zh: 我踩着雪走，骨节里塞满霜。
lines.en: I walk on snow with frost packed into my joints.

lines.zh: 每走一步，背上就抖落一片骨屑。
lines.en: Every step shakes a flake of bone off my back.

lines.zh: 雪太深，我的腿先于身子陷下去。
lines.en: The snow is deep; my legs sink before my body does.

lines.zh: 冰面太滑，我的爪子一直在打滑。
lines.en: The ice is slick and my claws keep slipping sideways.

lines.zh: 骨腿里没有肉，走起来只有咔哒。
lines.en: There is no flesh in these legs, only clicking.

lines.zh: 我爬过雪堆，留下八行小洞。
lines.en: I crawl over the snowdrift and leave eight rows of holes.

lines.zh: 冷风一吹，我好像又轻了一点。
lines.en: The cold wind blows and I feel a little lighter.

lines.zh: 关节冻住了，我得先把它掰开。
lines.en: My joints have frozen shut; I must pry them loose.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，像一把散开的骨梳。
lines.en: I sidle along like a comb of loosened bone.

lines.zh: 雪落在我背上，久久不化。
lines.en: Snow settles on my back and will not melt.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雪面结了一层薄壳。
lines.en: Where I pass, the snow crusts over in a thin shell.

lines.zh: 骨头太轻，风几乎推着我走。
lines.en: My bones are so light the wind nearly pushes me along.

lines.zh: 最后两条腿撑地，我把自己往前拖。
lines.en: My last two legs brace the ground and drag me forward.

lines.zh: 我沿冰河走，骨腿敲得很整齐。
lines.en: I cross the frozen river, bone legs knocking in time.

lines.zh: 雪地上我走出八条并行的浅痕。
lines.en: I leave eight shallow lines side by side in the snow.

lines.zh: 我趴在冰上说不出话，只能敲牙齿。
lines.en: I lie on the ice, wordless, and click my teeth.

lines.zh: 骨片卡在喉咙里，我咳不出来。
lines.en: A shard is stuck in my throat and I cannot cough it out.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛眼在雪地里泛着淡红的光。
lines.en: My spider eye glows faint red against the snow.

lines.zh: 我数自己的腿，数到七就乱了。
lines.en: I count my own legs and lose track at seven.

lines.zh: 冰下有条鱼，我盯了很久没动。
lines.en: A fish moves under the ice; I watch without stirring.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在冷里缩紧，发出细响。
lines.en: My bones tighten in the cold and give a thin whistle.

lines.zh: 我把自己挂在枯枝上晾着。
lines.en: I hang myself on a dead branch to dry.

lines.zh: 这具身子不用吃，也不会饱。
lines.en: This body never eats, and never feels full.

lines.zh: 雪盖住我的背，我就假装是块石头。
lines.en: Snow covers my back and I pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，掉下三片碎骨。
lines.en: I shudder and three chips of bone fall off.

lines.zh: 风从骨缝里穿过，像有人在吹哨。
lines.en: Wind passes through my ribs like someone whistling.

lines.zh: 我在等雪停，雪从不问我要什么。
lines.en: I wait for the snow to stop; it never asks me anything.

lines.zh: 你把呼吸吐成白雾，我盯着那团雾。
lines.en: Your breath fogs white and I stare at that cloud.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我的蜘蛛眼也跟着眨。
lines.en: When you blink, my spider eye blinks with you.

lines.zh: 你身上有火的味道，我很久没闻到了。
lines.en: You smell of fire; I have not smelled it in ages.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，用八只眼找你脖子。
lines.en: I tilt my head and search your neck with eight eyes.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就当你是一根柱子。
lines.en: Stand still and I will take you for a post.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我的骨屑。
lines.en: Your boots have crushed the bone dust I left.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有几处是暖的。
lines.en: I am counting how many places on you are warm.

lines.zh: 你越靠近，我的腿敲得越快。
lines.en: The closer you come, the faster my legs tap.

lines.zh: 别动，我正看着你呼出的霜。
lines.en: Do not move; I am watching the frost you breathe.

lines.zh: 你背后有雪，我背后只有骨头。
lines.en: There is snow behind you; behind me there is only bone.

lines.zh: 骨头断了一节，我还剩七条腿。
lines.en: One bone breaks and I still have seven legs.

lines.zh: 你砍开的裂缝里没有血。
lines.en: The gash you cut has no blood inside.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，只是我喊不响。
lines.en: There is pain, only I cannot cry it out.

lines.zh: 我的骨片掉了一地，捡不回来。
lines.en: My shards litter the ground and I cannot gather them.

lines.zh: 这一下把霜都震落了。
lines.en: That blow shakes all the frost off me.

lines.zh: 我裂开的地方，会被冷风补上。
lines.en: Where I crack, the cold wind fills me in.

lines.zh: 你敲碎的那节骨，原本就松。
lines.en: The joint you shattered was already loose to begin with.

lines.zh: 别停手，我还在动。
lines.en: Do not stop swinging; I am still moving.

lines.zh: 我的腿抖了，但没松。
lines.en: My legs tremble, but they do not let go.

lines.zh: 骨头碎了不响，只有我听见。
lines.en: Broken bone makes no sound except to me.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我只想要你的热气。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I only want your warmth.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，我的腿却绕开它。
lines.en: You set down meat, and my legs walk around it.

lines.zh: 骨蜘蛛不需要喂，只需要冷。
lines.en: A bone spider needs no feeding, only cold.

lines.zh: 那块冰比任何食物都合我胃口。
lines.en: That block of ice suits my appetite better than any food.

lines.zh: 我凑近火把，又烫得退回来。
lines.en: I lean toward the torch, then flinch back from the heat.

lines.zh: 你要是给我骨头，我会收下。
lines.en: If you offer me a bone, I will accept it.

lines.zh: 食物对我只是多一块压腿的石头。
lines.en: Food to me is only another stone weighing down a leg.

lines.zh: 我闻着你的手，不为吃，为暖。
lines.en: I sniff your hand, not to eat, but for warmth.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，引不动我的腿。
lines.en: The grass in your hand cannot move my legs.

lines.zh: 别用小麦，我不是那种蜘蛛。
lines.en: Skip the wheat; I am not that kind of spider.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，骨头硌得你后退。
lines.en: You bump into me and my bones knock you back.

lines.zh: 我身上没有软的地方，只有棱角。
lines.en: There is nothing soft on me, only edges.

lines.zh: 你的袖子挂住了一片骨片。
lines.en: A bone shard has caught on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你就带走我的一块霜。
lines.en: One touch and you carry off a piece of my frost.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，腿却还站着。
lines.en: I am knocked askew, yet my legs still stand.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的关节比我先动。
lines.en: Forgive me; my joints moved before I did.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的腿，我只听见一声脆响。
lines.en: You step on my leg and I hear one crisp snap.

lines.zh: 我的骨头顶着你的肋骨，谁也没让。
lines.en: My bones press your ribs and neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 别挤，我这副架子经不起碰撞。
lines.en: Do not shove; this frame of mine cannot take collisions.

lines.zh: 你退开时，雪里多了几片骨头。
lines.en: As you step back, a few bones remain in the snow.

lines.zh: 我们不用血肉，只把骨头靠在一起。
lines.en: We need no flesh; we simply lean bone against bone.

lines.zh: 两只骨蜘蛛相遇，先敲三下作礼。
lines.en: Two bone spiders meet and tap three times in greeting.

lines.zh: 交配时我们不拥抱，只交换骨片。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we trade shards of bone.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣比我少两条腿，也一样冷。
lines.en: My mate has two legs fewer and is just as cold.

lines.zh: 我们的卵是冰里的一小把碎骨。
lines.en: Our eggs are a small handful of bone in ice.

lines.zh: 没有心跳可以对齐，我们对齐咔哒声。
lines.en: No heartbeats to align, so we align our clicking.

lines.zh: 它敲我的背，我敲回去，就这样。
lines.en: It taps my back; I tap back. That is all.

lines.zh: 找伴不难，冷的地方大家都往一块挤。
lines.en: Finding a mate is easy where the cold drives all together.

lines.zh: 雪停之前，我们会一直靠在一起。
lines.en: We will stay pressed together until the snow stops.

lines.zh: 我们不算相爱，只算冻在一处。
lines.en: We are not in love; we are merely frozen in one place.

lines.zh: 我没有能抓握的手，只有尖爪。
lines.en: I have no grasping hand, only pointed claws.

lines.zh: 骨片滚过来，我用牙齿咬住。
lines.en: A shard rolls near and I catch it in my teeth.

lines.zh: 地上的线缠住我的腿，越挣越紧。
lines.en: String on the ground tangles my leg the more I pull.

lines.zh: 别人掉的东西，我拖进雪堆里藏。
lines.en: What others drop, I drag into the snow to hide.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚蜘蛛眼，又掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a spider eye and drop it again.

lines.zh: 太重的东西我抬不动，只能推。
lines.en: What I cannot lift, I shove across the snow.

lines.zh: 我的猎物不需要拿走，只要冻住。
lines.en: My prey need not be carried off, only frozen.

lines.zh: 掉在我面前的东西，都算遗物。
lines.en: Whatever falls before me counts as a relic.

lines.zh: 我叼着骨片走，像叼着自己的影子。
lines.en: I carry a shard like carrying my own shadow.

lines.zh: 爪子太细，夹不住第二件东西。
lines.en: My claws are too thin to hold a second thing.

lines.zh: 你踏进雪原，我的腿就停住了。
lines.en: You step onto the snowfield and my legs go still.

lines.zh: 活人的热气在冷里太显眼。
lines.en: Living warmth stands out too plainly in the cold.

lines.zh: 我听见你心跳，比雪落还响。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat, louder than falling snow.

lines.zh: 十步之内，我的骨片已经上膛。
lines.en: Within ten paces my bone shard is already loaded.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: The white fog of your breath gives away your position.

lines.zh: 我不追最壮的，我追最暖的。
lines.en: I do not chase the strongest; I chase the warmest.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就在那回头里。
lines.en: You look back once, and I am inside that glance.

lines.zh: 霜告诉我你走了哪条路。
lines.en: The frost tells me which path you took.

lines.zh: 别跑，雪会记住你的脚印。
lines.en: Do not run; the snow remembers your footprints.

lines.zh: 我的眼没有瞳，只认得热。
lines.en: My eyes have no pupils; they know only heat.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我反而看清了你。
lines.en: Raise the torch, and I see you all the better.

lines.zh: 这具骨架子醒了，只为你一个人。
lines.en: This bone frame has woken for you alone.

lines.zh: 我在你身后转，骨节一声接一声。
lines.en: I circle behind you, joint after joint clicking.

lines.zh: 我的腿压低，准备弹出去。
lines.en: My legs crouch low, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 骨片在颚间磨，声音像砂纸。
lines.en: Bone shards grind in my jaws like sandpaper.

lines.zh: 你退半格，我的腿已经跟上半格。
lines.en: You give half a block and my legs have already taken it.

lines.zh: 我贴着雪面走，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I skim the snow, trying to make no sound.

lines.zh: 我在找你的脚踝，那里最暖。
lines.en: I am looking for your ankle, the warmest part.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我看得一清二楚。
lines.en: I see your raised shield perfectly well.

lines.zh: 我的八只眼分开看，却只看一件事。
lines.en: My eight eyes look separately and see only one thing.

lines.zh: 雪在我脚下压实，像一条路。
lines.en: The snow packs under me like a road.

lines.zh: 别转身，转身要花时间。
lines.en: Do not turn around; turning costs you time.

lines.zh: 我把骨片含在嘴里，先不发射。
lines.en: I hold the shard in my mouth, not yet firing.

lines.zh: 你听见的咔哒，是我在数距离。
lines.en: The clicking you hear is me measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 骨片射出去，扎进你的肩。
lines.en: The bone shard flies and buries itself in your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的前腿一挑，划开你的袖子。
lines.en: My front leg hooks up and opens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我用骨头的棱角撞你。
lines.en: I do not bite; I strike you with the edges of bone.

lines.zh: 这一下不深，冷会替我加深。
lines.en: The cut is shallow; the cold will deepen it for me.

lines.zh: 骨片碎了，我嘴里还剩一把。
lines.en: That shard shattered; I still have a mouthful left.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就地弹起，腿先到。
lines.en: You retreat; I spring and my legs arrive first.

lines.zh: 我的爪子没有毒，只有寒气。
lines.en: My claws carry no venom, only bitter cold.

lines.zh: 这一击是我全部重量的落点。
lines.en: This blow is where all my weight lands.

lines.zh: 你护住脸，我就去够你的手腕。
lines.en: You guard your face, so I reach for your wrist.

lines.zh: 打完我自己也散了几节。
lines.en: After striking, a few of my joints come loose.

lines.zh: 雪原深处，一副骨架子撑起了腿。
lines.en: Deep in the snowfield, a bone frame lifts its legs.

lines.zh: 我从冻土里爬出来，身上还挂着霜。
lines.en: I claw out of the frozen soil still wearing frost.

lines.zh: 没有血肉，只有被冷风拼好的骨头。
lines.en: No flesh, only bones assembled by the cold wind.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见声音，是自己在咔哒。
lines.en: The first sound I hear is my own clicking.

lines.zh: 这地方够冷，够我活很久。
lines.en: This place is cold enough for me to last a long while.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆下站起来，抖掉一身白。
lines.en: I rise from under the drift and shake off the white.

lines.zh: 出生时我就知道该往哪儿走。
lines.en: At birth I already knew which way to walk.

lines.zh: 别怕，我只是冷，不是饿。
lines.en: Do not fear me; I am cold, not hungry.

lines.zh: 雪落在新生的骨头上，我就算长成了。
lines.en: Snow on new bone means I have finished growing.

lines.zh: 这片白地，从此有八条腿在走。
lines.en: This white ground now has eight legs walking it.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的关节就裂开了。
lines.en: Fire bakes my joints until they split apart.

lines.zh: 落地时我散成一小堆骨头。
lines.en: I land as a small heap of scattered bones.

lines.zh: 水漫过骨头，我沉得比石头快。
lines.en: Water covers my bones and I sink faster than stone.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹成一地碎骨。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into bone chips on the ground.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞里透进光。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and light shows in the hole.

lines.zh: 那股药味让我的骨头直响。
lines.en: That potion smell sets my bones rattling.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿不死，只会更轻。
lines.en: I eat nothing, cannot starve, and only grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打在骨头上，我整具架子亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my bones and the whole frame glows.

lines.zh: 虚空把骨头一根根拆开带走。
lines.en: The void takes my bones apart, one by one.
